_: The launch configuration for the one engine that answers everything. Committed, because the original sin here was that NO committed launch config existed anywhere: the engine serving apocky.com was traced to an EXIT trap inside a throwaway benchmark script, which a reboot would have lost silently. Every value is measured on this machine or cited; see apocrypha-core/tools/ENGINE_DIALS.csl for the evidence behind each one.

notes.-ncmoe 30: MoE experts placed on CPU. Measured +46% mean generation on the coder at -c 8192 (8.57 -> 12.50 tok/s, 3 samples each, every placed sample beat every unplaced one). The sweep 12/18/24/30/36 gave 7.35/8.13/8.36/17.44/15.97, so the knee sits between 24 and 30. N! transfer this number to another model or context.
notes.-ngl 99: Only safe BECAUSE -ncmoe is set. Alone it defeats b9743's own memory fitter: 'n_gpu_layers already set by user to 99, abort'. The -ncmoe run emits no such abort. Never remove one without the other.
notes.-c 32768 -np 2: Two slots of 16384 each, confirmed live via /slots. Two slots is what stops a long agent turn parking an interactive message behind it -- the whole point of one model serving everything.
notes.-fa on + q8_0 KV: Must move together. -fa off with quantized KV aborts outright: 'V cache quantization requires flash_attn'. The widely-cited turn-off-flash-attention-on-Arc advice is SYCL-scoped; this is Vulkan and it works.
notes.-cram 1024: The 8192 MiB default prompt cache is what turns a working engine into an OOM two minutes later on a 16 GiB card.
notes.--mlock: DELIBERATELY ABSENT. 20+ GiB of CPU-side experts against 31.8 GiB of RAM is the flag that hangs the desktop.
